title: View Stats
description: Open Player Statistics for a single roster member using the chart icon on their row — the same member used in the match history showcase.

steps.title: Players list
steps.body: Tutorial PlayerOnly has rating history from the seeded completed Round Robin. Single-player stats open from the row chart icon.

steps.title: Open stats for the player
steps.body: Tap the chart icon on the player’s row to open Player Statistics for that member alone.
steps.actionHint: Click the chart icon on the player row

steps.title: Player Statistics
steps.body: Player Statistics shows rating history for the selected member. Toggle series above the chart if more than one player is loaded.
steps.resultNote: Statistics page opened for one player via the row chart icon.
